title: Share exact parser budgets across composed resources
api_or_output: Internal optional OperationBudget injection and byte-adapter final source identity; no public API change

acceptance.description: Add optional internal shared OperationBudget to core constructor and byte DOM adapter, retaining unchanged default behavior. Supplied budget options authoritative; byte adapter source URI reaches decoder/core/diagnostics. No scanning or callback algorithm changes.

Focused char/byte tests prove aggregate exact/one-over Unicode scalar and expansion counters across parses, depth release, default independent behavior, declared encoding and final source identity. Preserve earlier functionality/public API.

Record tested implementation and integrated focused evidence using only verified dependencies. Constructor-only change has no new steady-state algorithm; cumulative allocation regressions remain milestone gate.

handoff.summary: Owning repair requested by catalog and XInclude workers; candidates preserved and metadata PARK acknowledged.
